original_coverage_E: Dhaka district only (Dhaka metropolis incl. Savar, Keraniganj, Dohar, Nawabganj)
changes_vs_old: Renamed from Dhaka North. Dhaka district (single ADM2, ~15.8m) cannot be split without ADM3, so old Dhaka North/South pair becomes one Dhaka seat plus a Padma-basin seat (192).
notes: Single ADM2 fits one seat; no ADM3 split needed. ADM1 Dhaka and ADM2 Dhaka share a name. Spelling follows census/Wikipedia (Chattogram=Chittagong, Cumilla=Comilla, Jashore=Jessore, Bogura=Bogra); ADM1 written Chittagong/Barisal.

original_coverage_E: Narayanganj, Munshiganj, Faridpur, Gopalganj, Shariatpur, Madaripur, Rajbari (Dhaka division) + Magura, Narail (Khulna division)
coverage_T: Bangladesh (Dhaka (Narayanganj, Munshiganj, Faridpur, Gopalganj, Shariatpur, Madaripur, Rajbari ADM2 only), Khulna (Magura, Narail ADM2 only))
changes_vs_old: Redrawn: now the Padma-basin districts south of Dhaka (incl. Narayanganj, moved from old seat 194).
notes: Contiguous: Narayanganj-Munshiganj-Shariatpur-Madaripur-Gopalganj/Faridpur-Rajbari-Magura/Narail share borders (Padma crossings are established bridge/ferry links).

coverage_T: Bangladesh (Dhaka (Gazipur, Narsingdi, Tangail, Manikganj ADM2 only))
changes_vs_old: Boundary defined; constituency renamed (was Gazipur-Greater Dhaka).
notes: Contiguous: Gazipur borders Narsingdi and Tangail; Manikganj borders Tangail and Gazipur.

original_coverage_E: Mymensingh division (Mymensingh, Jamalpur, Netrokona, Sherpur) + Kishoreganj district
changes_vs_old: Renamed from Narayanganj-Brahmaputra; Narayanganj moved to seat 192 and Mymensingh division added (it had no seat in the old sheet).
notes: Kishoreganj borders Netrokona and Mymensingh; part of greater Mymensingh region.

original_coverage_E: Chattogram, Cox’s Bazar, Feni and the three Hill Tracts districts (Rangamati, Bandarban, Khagrachhari)
coverage_T: Bangladesh (Chittagong (Chittagong, Cox's Bazar, Rangamati, Bandarban, Khagrachhari, Feni ADM2 only))
changes_vs_old: Merged old seats 195 (Chattogram) and 196 (Cox’s Bazar-Hill Tracts): eastern Bangladesh (Chattogram + Sylhet divisions) totals only ~2.9 seats, so 4 seats there would be ~11m each. Old seat 196 reused for western Bangladesh.
notes: Contiguous along the coast. Cox's Bazar census count may only partly include Rohingya camp residents; scaling fixes the country total.

original_coverage_E: Jashore, Kushtia, Jhenaidah, Chuadanga, Meherpur (Khulna division) + Pabna, Sirajganj (Rajshahi division)
coverage_T: Bangladesh (Khulna (Jashore, Kushtia, Jhenaidah, Chuadanga, Meherpur ADM2 only), Rajshahi (Pabna, Sirajganj ADM2 only))
changes_vs_old: Repurposed from Cox’s Bazar-Hill Tracts to a western/central Bangladesh seat (see 195); renamed.
notes: Contiguous: Kushtia borders Pabna; Pabna borders Sirajganj; Jashore-Jhenaidah-Kushtia-Chuadanga-Meherpur adjoining. Bengali-speaking throughout.

coverage_T: Bangladesh (Chittagong (Cumilla, Chandpur, Lakshmipur, Noakhali ADM2 only))
changes_vs_old: Renamed (Eastern Bengal -> Noakhali); Feni to 195, Brahmanbaria to 198.

original_coverage_E: Sylhet division (Sylhet, Sunamganj, Habiganj, Moulvibazar) + Brahmanbaria
changes_vs_old: Brahmanbaria added so the seat reaches the band (Sylhet division alone ~11.6m).

original_coverage_E: Rajshahi division except Pabna and Sirajganj (Rajshahi, Natore, Chapai Nawabganj, Naogaon, Bogura, Joypurhat) + Gaibandha (Rangpur division)
coverage_T: Bangladesh (Rajshahi (Rajshahi, Natore, Chapai Nawabganj, Naogaon, Bogura, Joypurhat ADM2 only), Rangpur (Gaibandha ADM2 only))
changes_vs_old: Boundary defined; Gaibandha taken from Rangpur division to balance.
notes: Gaibandha borders Bogura and Joypurhat. Contiguous.

original_coverage_E: Rangpur division except Gaibandha (Rangpur, Nilphamari, Dinajpur, Thakurgaon, Kurigram, Lalmonirhat, Panchagarh)
coverage_T: Bangladesh (Rangpur (Rangpur, Nilphamari, Dinajpur, Thakurgaon, Kurigram, Lalmonirhat, Panchagarh ADM2 only))

original_coverage_E: Barisal division (Barishal, Patuakhali, Bhola, Pirojpur, Barguna, Jhalokati) + Khulna, Bagerhat, Satkhira
coverage_T: Bangladesh (Barisal [entire ADM1], Khulna (Khulna, Bagerhat, Satkhira ADM2 only))
notes: Contiguous: Pirojpur borders Bagerhat; Bagerhat-Khulna-Satkhira in a row; coastal delta/Sundarbans.

original_coverage_E: Koshi province + Bagmati province (incl. Kathmandu Valley) + eastern Madhesh districts (Saptari, Siraha, Dhanusha, Mahottari, Sarlahi)
coverage_T: Nepal (Koshi [entire ADM1], Bagmati [entire ADM1], Madhesh (Saptari, Siraha, Dhanusha, Mahottari, Sarlahi ADM2 only))
changes_vs_old: Koshi and five eastern Madhesh districts added; boundary defined.
notes: Nepal ADM1 = 7 provinces, ADM2 = 77 districts (current structure). Contiguous: Koshi borders Saptari/Siraha; Sarlahi borders Mahottari and Sindhuli. 2021 census scaled uniformly to ~30.6m (WPP-based).

original_coverage_E: Gandaki, Lumbini, Karnali and Sudurpashchim provinces + western Madhesh districts (Parsa, Bara, Rautahat)
coverage_T: Nepal (Gandaki [entire ADM1], Lumbini [entire ADM1], Karnali [entire ADM1], Sudurpashchim [entire ADM1], Madhesh (Parsa, Bara, Rautahat ADM2 only))
notes: Contiguous: Parsa borders Nawalpur (Gandaki) and Parasi (Lumbini). Terai districts likely growing faster than the uniform scaling assumes.

original_coverage_E: All Maldives plus Sri Lanka: Western, North Western and Sabaragamuwa provinces
coverage_T: Maldives [entire ADM0]; Sri Lanka (Western [entire ADM1], North Western [entire ADM1], Sabaragamuwa [entire ADM1])
pop_flag: LOW — 12.03m; Sri Lanka+Maldives (~23.6m) has only 2 seats, so both stay under 12.5m (this one 12.03m, seat 208 11.57m)
changes_vs_old: USER EDIT: Maldives moved here from seat 208 (keep Maldives with Western Sri Lanka/Colombo).
notes: LONG SEA LINK: Maldives to Colombo/Western Sri Lanka (~700-1,000 km by sea/air). Rest of seat contiguous by land. Maldives pop 0.53m.

coverage_T: Sri Lanka (Central [entire ADM1], Southern [entire ADM1], Uva [entire ADM1], North Central [entire ADM1], Northern [entire ADM1], Eastern [entire ADM1])
pop_flag: LOW — 11.57m; Sri Lanka+Maldives (~23.6m) has only 2 seats, so both stay under 12.5m
